title: Unit 46 Consolidation: Phone, Internet & Technology
goal: I can solve a small technology problem: say what froze or ran out of battery and what I did about it.
I can use a phone, e-mail and apps: phone someone, send a file, book and pay online, and run a video call.
grammar: Unit 46 Review: phone, internet, apps, technology problems and video calls
